instruction_model: alpha 1.0 or 1.1 cycles/instruction, rounded up once per public C operation; not silicon WCET. Callees are counted once, original hb31_process caller is absent.

kernel_hazards.reference: ESP32-S3 TRM v1.8 section 1.7.1 and Table 1.7-2 (pp65-74)
kernel_hazards.covered: Decoded kernel QR, QACC_H/L, SAR_BYTE, PIE postincrement AR and conservative ADDI register dependencies.
kernel_hazards.excluded_scope: Entry/return/caller control penalties, other instruction hardware-resource conflicts, fetch/cache/memory waits, ABI window spills, interrupts and cross-core contention. Zero operand interlocks is not zero total stalls or measured WCET.

scalar_control_hazard_budget.reference: ESP32-S3 TRM v1.8 sections 1.7.1 and 1.7.3; store-use +1 and call/return +2 are conservative allowances.

instructions.instruction_cost_unit: one executed instruction; callee entry/return included once

capacity.alpha_1_0_scope: Instruction-only reference; known control bubbles are omitted, so not an eligible physical timing claim.

event_model.source_bank_contract: Aligned 1024-sample blocks, batches of 1, 11 or 12; 11/12 represent 11264/12288-sample release bursts. One native bank remains reserved for RF, leaving at most two released banks. Actual variable native bank boundaries/ring-wrap assembly are not implemented. A maximum 125us switch-to-handoff delay is assumed, giving 303280-30000=273280 cycles from release to the declared deadline. The physical raw deadline applies to produce completion; work completion and reap must meet the same deadline as additional conservative conditions here.
event_model.external_contract: Every 64us reservation includes all outer dispatch/idle checks and RF/API/SDK work; actual SDK event counts are not connected. Core0 reservation completion is the assumed RF poll. Tick and WDT interrupt costs are charged separately.
event_model.transport_contract: 128KiB=8 DMA frames; 8 reaped outputs/frame, bounded API dispatch one 64us reservation before start and after wire completion, declared aggregate wire MB/s. This is not an implemented SPI route.
event_model.periodic_contract: One declared 1Hz interrupt service at each tested phase; busy-wait duration is a sensitivity parameter, not measured PHY time.
